questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that road work or construction is ahead. Follow the detour signs to avoid the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade or hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down now. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal to turn green before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you a steep hill is ahead. Be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to avoid blocking the intersection ahead. Drivers must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It alerts drivers that an extra lane is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass. Left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It warns drivers that a bridge with narrow lanes is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It alerts drivers that the road shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they can either turn right or go straight from this lane at the intersection. Drivers must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: A sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross this road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep downhill section of road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers not to enter a roadway from the wrong direction. It is often posted at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows that drivers from both directions may use the shared center lane only for turning left. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign indicates that U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up. Be ready to respond to yellow or red lights.
